name: Special Meeting of the City Council - Town Hall
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the
Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may be submitted
by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  COMMUNITY CENTER AT AJ PADELFORD PARK
  11870 169TH STREET
  ARTESIA, CA 90701

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2023
  6:30P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

CITY COUNCIL OPENING REMARKS

REPORTS

  1. Parks & Recreation Update
  2. Public Works Update
  3. Community Development Update

QUESTIONS/ANSWERS – Staff will provide responses to questions that are made in-
person or submitted to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us. Staff will also speak during the
meeting on a variety of issues of community importance. Topics that will be discussed
include but are not limited to parks, public works, road conditions, utility issues,
development, and City departments.

CITY COUNCIL CLOSING REMARKS

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
minutes_text:
ARTESIA  CITY  COUNCIL  SPECIAL  MEETING  MINUTES
  MONDAY,  SEPTEMBER  18, 2023,  6:30  P.M.
  COUNCIL  CHAMBERS,  18747  CLARKDALE  AVENUE,  ARTESIA,  CALIFORNIA

CALL  TO ORDER
Mayor  Manalo  called  the meeting  to order  at 6:40  p.m.

ROLL  CALL
Present:  Mayor Manalo,  Mayor  Pro Tem  Lima,  Councilmembers  Trevino,  and Ramoso
Absent:  Councilmember  Taj
Staff  Present:  City  Manager  Schindler,  Deputy  City  Manager  Burke,  Acting  City  Clerk
Alderete,  Parks  and  Recreation  Manager  Guerra,  Public  Works  Manager  Sanchez,
Community  Development  Director  Dor.  Interpreter  Villapudua  made  an announcement
regarding  translation  listening  devices.

CITY  COUNCIL  OPENING  REMARKS
Mayor  Manalo,  Mayor  Pro Tem  Lima,  Councilmembers  Trevino,  and Ramoso  asked
questions  and/or  provided  comments.

REPORTS
  1.  City Manager  Schindler  Introduced  Parks  and Recreation  Manager  Guerra,  who
  provided  an update  on department  business  and projects.  A resident  provided  a
  question  and/or  provided  comments.

  2.  City Manager  Schindler  Introduced  Public  Works  Manager  Sanchez,  who
  provided  an update  on department  business  and projects.  A resident  provided  a
  question  and/or  provided  comments.

  3.  City Manager  Schindler  Introduced  Community  Development  Director  Dor, who
  provided  an update  on department  business  and projects.

QUESTIONS/ANSWERS
Carol  Hernandez,  Ariana  Mora,  Joana  R., Lillian  Montoya,  Teresa,  Dan Rocha,  Sagar
Shah,  and Cindy  provided  questions  and/or  provided  comments.

CITY  COUNCIL  CLOSING  REMARKS
Mayor  Manalo,  Mayor  Pro Tem  Lima,  Councilmembers  Trevino,  and Ramoso  asked
questions  and/or  provided  comments.

ADJOURNMENT
The  meeting  was  adjourned  at 8:37  p.m.

Jennifer  Alderete,  Acting  City Clerk
